args.message: OpenStreetMap（开放街图，简称 OSM）是一个由全球志愿者共同创建的可自由编辑的世界地图项目，数据在开放许可下免费使用。它收集道路、河流、建筑、餐馆等地理信息，任何人都可以查看和贡献编辑。本助手的地图与路线数据即来自 OpenStreetMap。来源：openstreetmap.org

passages.title: EC40 2026 (25w46) User Manual
passages.text:
13.4.5.1. Tyre pressure monitoring
Your car can detect and indicate if the tyre pressure is low. Tyre pressure monitoring cannot be disabled. If
the system is unable to detect any tyre pressure, it will indicate that there's a malfunction.
For the tyre pressure monitoring system to provide updated information, you need to drive the car above 35 km/h (22 mph) for
several minutes.
An indicator symbol lights up if a low tyre pressure is detected in any of the tyres. It will stay illuminated until the problem is re‐
solved and a new reference value for the tyre pressure has been stored.
In addition to messages in the driver display, you can also find information about the tyre pressure monitoring in the car status
view.
If the tyre pressure monitoring system is not working correctly, the driver display's indicator symbol will first flash for approx‐
imately one minute and then remain lit. A message also appears on the driver display. If the fault is permanent, a service is re‐
quired.[1]
Remember that the system does not replace the need for regular tyre inspection and maintenance.

13.4.5.1. Tyre pressure monitoring
Your car can detect and indicate if the tyre pressure is low. Tyre pressure monitoring cannot be disabled. If
the system is unable to detect any tyre pressure, it will indicate that there's a malfunction.
For the tyre pressure monitoring system to provide updated information, you need to drive the car above 35 km/h (22 mph) for
several minutes.
An indicator symbol lights up if a low tyre pressure is detected in any of the tyres. It will stay illuminated until the problem is re‐
solved and a new reference value for the tyre pressure has been stored.
In addition to messages in the driver display, you can also find information about the tyre pressure monitoring in the car status
view.
If the tyre pressure monitoring system is not working correctly, the driver display's indicator symbol will first flash for approx‐
imately one minute and then remain lit. A message also appears on the driver display. If the fault is permanent, a service is re‐
quired.[1]
Remember that the system does not replace the need for regular tyre inspection and maintenance.
